what: Proposed /implement gate fence is not self-contained because it starts with read-session-env-key.sh but omits the required post-Step-0 CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT rehydration prelude
scenario_or_breakage: Fresh Bash blocks after Step 0 do not inherit CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, so the durable presence reads can fail before degraded-tools-gate.sh runs, leaving the root-cause fix ineffective
suggested_fix: Prepend the canonical plugin-root.env source guard to the new gate fence before the four read-session-env-key.sh reads, or explicitly state the gate fence must include the existing post-Step-0 Bash prelude
